lines: Din kuchh aise guzaarta hai koi
couplets.en: One gets through the day as though repaying a favor.

lines: Din kuchh aise guzaarta hai koi
couplets.en: That is how one gets through the day.
It was a comfort to look in the mirror.

lines: Humko is ghar mein jaanta hai koi
couplets.en: Someone in this house knows me.

lines: Humko is ghar mein jaanta hai koi
couplets.en: Someone in this house knows me.

lines: Pak gaya hai shajar pe phal shayad
couplets.en: Perhaps the fruit on the tree has ripened.

lines: Phir se patthar uchhaalta hai koi
Din kuchh aise guzaarta hai koi
couplets.en: As though repaying a favor, one gets through the day.

lines: Tumhare gham ki dali utha kar
Zabaan pe rakh li hai dekho maine
couplets.en: See, I have taken a lump of your sorrow and set it on my tongue.

lines: Main qatra-qatra hi jee raha hoon
couplets.en: It melts drop by drop, and drop by drop I go on living.
The silences have been echoing for a while.
It is as though someone were calling to me.
